verdict.rationale: The axis applies: CRA runs digital services, including the system-to-system EFILE transmission channel, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it issues scoped, least-privilege API credentials. The evidence shows no such capability. EFILE uses a single filer number and password tied to certified software, and representative authorization ("authorize access to online information", Represent a Client) is a human-delegation feature, an adjacent control rather than scoped agent API credentials.
